tasks.title: Turn the AI request into a measurable user decision

acceptance.description: Turn the AI request into a measurable user decision with a reproducible observable result
acceptance.evidence_oracle: An evaluator can distinguish the proposed classifier, deterministic dispatch and manual triage. Removing the deadline or label owner leaves a specific open requirement. A rollout cannot inherit an invented target.

tasks.title: Specify corpus ownership and leakage controls

acceptance.description: Specify corpus ownership and leakage controls with a reproducible observable result
acceptance.evidence_oracle: A reviewer can reproduce partition membership and isolate held-out or withdrawn records. With future labels or unknown rights, the affected use stays unresolved and the unaffected case remains testable.

tasks.title: Join evaluation evidence to a release decision

acceptance.description: Join evaluation evidence to a release decision with a reproducible observable result
acceptance.evidence_oracle: On K1 recompute both classifiers’ results. A release recommendation cites its exact policy. On K2 a correct document with an unsupported answer fails the answer criterion while retrieval retains its own result. A judge favoring first position on identical-content pairs produces a calibration finding. No fixed vendor or judge rank can clear a failed deterministic product criterion. The K1 regression fixture rejects a mislabeled scorer and distinguishes MSE of 1/3 from R-squared of 7/8.

tasks.title: Specify a supervised build and operator recovery

acceptance.description: Specify a supervised build and operator recovery with a reproducible observable result
acceptance.evidence_oracle: Using the filled K3 specification, a reviewer identifies the public entry point, independent oracle owner, expected failing behavior, correct retry behavior, the plausible wrong fix and the legacy-data invariant. The document assigns execution and actual revision receipts to D07/E05 and their reconciliation to C04. For K4 it names the operator, compatible artifact tuple and expected rollback outcome. A walkthrough can reject a specification that omits replay or legacy behavior before engineering begins.

tasks.title: Prove the documentation handoff is usable

acceptance.description: Prove the documentation handoff is usable with a reproducible observable result
acceptance.evidence_oracle: Hand the packet to a fresh reader. The reader finds the same case ID and scoped decision for each valid case. A mismatched dataset revision and a missing outcome each prevent acceptance. Record the files and handoff revision.
